body: Justin Herbert is the subject of conflicting trade signals: while Gridiron Heroics reports that Cleveland Browns are linked to a blockbuster deal with the Chargers, NDtv Sports states that Los Angeles Chargers have shut down Justin Herbert trade talk with Minnesota Vikings. Yahoo Sports and CBS Sports list both teams as potential landing spots, though no agreement has been reached.

findings.evidence_quote: Los Angeles Chargers Shut Down Justin Herbert Trade Talk With Minnesota Vikings
Browns Linked To Blockbuster Justin Herbert Trade With Chargers
